text.tspan: Annual rate of people left homeless by all natural disasters excluding
Rates are measured per 100,000 people. Disasters include events such as earthquakes, volcanoes, droughts, wildfires,
storms, and floods. Extreme temperatures are not included here because their geographical and time coverage is poor,
Data source: EM-DAT, CRED / UCLouvain (2026); Population based on various sources (2024)
Note: Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting
